summary: Iteration 18 full-stack QA on preview URL for Tier-1 Revenue suite (bundles, promo codes + analytics, gift-a-seat, revenue dashboard, best-sellers, abandoned-nudge, countdown timers, blueprint PDFs, admin CMS incl. inactive). Backend: 40/40 pytest cases pass (new file test_iteration18_revenue.py). Frontend: verified /products (bundles + bundle-countdown badge + Save badge + lead-magnet done + non-blueprint Buy opens checkout-modal with promo + gift-toggle + gift-fields; Blueprint CTA links to /assessment), /cohorts (grid + cohort-countdown-cxo-leadership-cohort live badge 'Launch offer ends in 6d 23:50:51' + seats badge + reserve opens checkout-modal), /corporate (corporate-done shown after submit), /case-studies (grid + testimonials-section), and admin Revenue tab (admin-revenue with all 8 sub-tabs including dashboard/products/cohorts/case-studies/testimonials/bundles/promo-codes/orders, promo-copy-* button present, nudge-abandoned button on orders sub-tab, Promo-codes + Bundles New/Save/Delete cycle all working). No 'AI' word found on any public page. Live Razorpay LIVE order creation returns real order_id/amount_paise for product 99900 / cohort / bundle 2299900 — NO payment completed. 20%-off promo applied to ₹999 product returns final_price 799; duplicate promo code -> 400, missing code -> 400. Full cohort correctly returns waitlist:true. Admin CMS list endpoint returns inactive items (fixes iter17's ghost-create bug).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 5745 lines. Tier-1 revenue features keep accreting at the bottom of the monolith — split into routers/commerce.py, routers/promo.py, routers/cms.py, routers/analytics.py, routers/blueprint.py before adding more.

cms_upsert still accepts arbitrary dict without Pydantic validation — an admin typo (price as string, missing product_slug on bundle) silently corrupts catalogue docs and the public /bundles response then shows product_title/cohort_title = null. Add per-collection Pydantic models.
on_event('startup')/('shutdown') still used (FastAPI DeprecationWarning) — migrate to lifespan handlers.

commerce_order gift path only validates presence of recipient_email inside CheckoutModal, but backend accepts arbitrary gift dict without shape validation (no email format / max-length checks). Consider a GiftIn Pydantic sub-model with EmailStr + length caps to prevent stored-XSS-like payloads in gift.message.

_resolve_promo compares expires_at with `str(exp) < now_iso()` — string compare works for ISO-8601 UTC but fails if a naive/local timestamp is ever stored (e.g. admin sets 'YYYY-MM-DD'). Prefer datetime parsing and timezone-aware comparison.

commerce/verify branch for kind=='bundle' only increments cohort seats when payment already verified; but if bundle.product_slug points to a blueprint-type product with meta.scores, no personalized-blueprint URL is generated (only cohorts get seats, product gets starter.pdf). Not a bug today (seeded bundle uses playbook), but a footgun if a bundle is CMS-created around the Blueprint product.

commerce_best_sellers returns null for both keys when there are no PAID orders — Products/Cohorts pages consume it and only render 'Most popular' when non-null (safe), but on brand-new preview envs the badge will never appear until first real charge.
admin_nudge_abandoned depends on GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD being set (best-effort); on the current preview it silently returns sent:0 which is expected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested assertions (bundles/countdown/gift/promo/reserve/corporate/case-studies/admin Revenue 8 sub-tabs + promo & bundle CRUD)
